snippet.title: Dragon Collection Trailer Spring 2025 | Banana
snippet.description:
Hello everyone!

We're excited to announce the trailer for our upcoming Dragon Collection!
It will have different types of skins between each banana, and maybe a little surprise with each!

Join us on discord to know more!
discord.gg/thebananas
